ratingMeaning: Historical postgame player ratings from Chess.com monthly archives
caveat: Biased observational pilot; not a calibrated Elo model or population estimate.

sampling.clockStratification: None; game time controls are reported but remaining clock is not modeled
sampling.playerSplit: SHA-256(seed,player-split-v1,lowercase username), 80% train/20% holdout; both players must match
sampling.aggregateProfile: Independent per-Elo reservoir over all phases (natural corpus phase frequencies)
